[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] '''meditation chamber''' was located in the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|EmPal SuRecon]] center.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Palpytrueface.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sidious in his meditation chamber.]]
A small, circular room adjoined to the operating theater by thick transparisteel windows, this room closely resembled [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] former office in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. On one side of the room were a semicircle of padded couches, on the other three shell-shaped swivel chairs. In the center and on the sides of the room were three conical holoprojectors.
